create.name: Gen Kelsang Wangpo
create.bio:
Gen Kelsang Wangpo is an American Buddhist monk in the New Kadampa Tradition and the resident teacher of Kadampa Meditation Center Texas, whose main temple is in central Dallas and whose branch classes reach towns from Fort Worth and Plano to Austin, Houston and Lubbock. He has followed the teachings of Geshe Kelsang Gyatso, the tradition's founder, for over two decades, and has been giving Dharma classes himself since 2004.

His aim is to make Kadam Buddhism usable in a busy city life rather than something set apart from it. In Dallas he leads Saturday morning workshops for newcomers that alternate short talks with guided meditation, weekend courses on harder subjects such as emptiness, the way things actually exist, and introductory afternoons on the Vajrasattva purification practice. He also grants empowerments, teaches a closed series on the Eleven Yogas for Highest Yoga Tantra practitioners, and takes the teachings out of the temple: in November 2026 he gives a talk and guided meditation on contemplating death at the Nasher Sculpture Center, tied to an exhibition there. Seasonal gatherings, such as a Friendsgiving teaching on gratitude and a free Christmas Eve evening of meditation and prayers for world peace, round out the year. He has no books or recordings of his own; his classes draw on Geshe Kelsang's books.

courses.title: Rest & Renewal: Learn to Meditate
courses.description: A three-hour Saturday morning workshop at the Dallas temple for people new to meditation, in two teaching and meditation sessions with a break between. Open to all; members can join by livestream.

courses.title: Memento Mori: Extracting Profound Meaning from Art
courses.description: A public talk with guided meditation at the Nasher Sculpture Center in Dallas, using Bruce Nauman's exhibition there as a starting point for the Buddhist practice of reflecting on our own death. A tour of the exhibition follows, and entry to it is included.

courses.title: Sunday Friendsgiving - Gratitude and Harmony
courses.description: A Sunday teaching around Thanksgiving on how kindness and gratitude support good relationships and communities, followed by a shared potluck lunch. No registration needed.

courses.title: An Afternoon of Purification - Introduction to Vajrasattva Practice
courses.description: Four guided sessions over an afternoon and evening introducing the Buddhist purification practice of Vajrasattva: regret, reliance, mantra recitation and a promise to change. It opens the centre's yearly self-guided Vajrasattva retreat.

courses.title: Targeting the Illusion: Emptiness Course and Retreat
courses.description: A two-day weekend course at the Dallas temple on emptiness in Buddhist philosophy, focusing on how to identify the false way things seem to exist so that meditation can see past it. Six sessions, with a vegetarian lunch on the Saturday; Saturday-only places are available.
courses.price: $30 USD ($25 USD concessions; Saturday only $20 USD)

free_resources.title: Prayers for World Peace: Inner Calm, Radiant Joy
free_resources.description: A free Christmas Eve evening (24 December 2026, 5 to 6:30 pm) at the Dallas temple, with a guided meditation, a short talk on inner peace and how to extend it to others, and prayers for world peace. Free, with registration requested.
